objective: Verify and harden visual authoring, revision restore, and scheduled publication with isolated tests and a local browser workflow.
scope: Visual editor selection, paste, source mode and sanitized preview
Publisher/editor boundaries for live and scheduled articles
Scheduled publishing cancellation, retry and lock behavior
outOfScope: Production publishing, Ghost cutover, or VPS worker activation
Unrelated CRM modules and messaging providers

acceptance.description: Editors cannot publish or change live/scheduled articles; publishers can perform valid transitions
acceptance.evidence: Focused CMS tests pass: editors may draft/review but cannot publish, schedule, unschedule or modify protected live/scheduled content.

acceptance.description: Publication rejects empty content and invalid dates; publish-now and rescheduling are correct
acceptance.evidence: Focused tests pass for empty sanitized content, invalid/past/missing-timezone schedules, UTC normalization, publish-now and date preservation. Browser confirmed saved timestamps refresh correctly.

acceptance.description: Snapshots and restores preserve URL/state, detect stale edits, and tolerate retry without duplicate history
acceptance.evidence: Focused tests pass for deterministic snapshots after failed writes, stale/foreign/unauthorized restore rejection, preserved URL/state/metadata, and pre-mutation audit failure. Browser restored an earlier bold body successfully.

acceptance.description: Scheduled publication rechecks current state under the shared lock and handles cancellation, contention, failure and restart safely
acceptance.evidence: Scheduler tests pass for cancellation/rescheduling, contention/concurrent workers, retry, lost acknowledgment and invalid records. Crash-left locks deliberately fail closed with operator recovery documented. Live posts schedule index/query passed read-only; worker not activated.

acceptance.description: Isolated browser workflow verifies typing/cursor, formatting, source sanitization, saved state and revision restore
acceptance.evidence: Built-app browser workflow passed against in-memory synthetic API: typing/cursor, bold, plaintext paste, unsafe source sanitization, save feedback, revision restore, schedule normalization, publish-now, Undo/Redo. Fixed visible text clearing and stale form values found during these checks.

acceptance.description: Feature tests, typecheck and production build pass; checkpoint and next steps are recorded
acceptance.evidence: Final session:verify passed typecheck, all 48 tests, and production build. Vault links and source credential scan passed. Production/provider activation remains separate.

nextActions.action: Archive this completed CMS-03 state and start a bounded MEDIA-01 session. Provision only editorial media metadata as needed; do not activate other modules.

Define and verify media upload size/signature checks, editor versus publisher permissions, private preview, explicit publish/unpublish visibility and failure compensation using isolated records. Verify actual Appwrite storage behavior before declaring media ready.
Keep publishing/reminder workers and Ghost cutover disabled until rollout gates pass. For main merge, isolate accepted work from staged modules and retain rollback refs.

knownRisks: New operations, document, media, reminder, and team modules have code but have not received feature-level end-to-end verification; they must not be labeled complete.
Media metadata collection exists in local schema but was added after the most recent remote setup; provision and verify before using the media page.
Remote locks fail closed after a process crash; stale-lock recovery and worker crash/retry behavior need a dedicated verification session.
Two private buckets were created with antivirus enabled, but actual upload/scan/download behavior is not yet verified.
Development work is checkpointed on codex/crm-workspace. It contains explicitly staged modules; do not merge into main or deploy before their acceptance checks pass.

Publishing locks deliberately fail closed after a process crash. Lost acknowledgments can leave pending audit intents requiring reconciliation; operator recovery is documented and automatic lease recovery is not implemented.
